## What changed
Revenue moved from $121.0B to $131.5B — +8.6% ($10.4B) from 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q1.

## Why
- **Search Ads** (53% of the move, $5.9B): Search Ads +11.0% ($5.9B, volume-led)
- **Cloud** (29% of the move, $3.2B): Cloud +32.0% ($3.2B, volume-led)

## What's driving it
- Search Ads: volume $4.2B of $5.9B
- Search Ads: paid_clicks +7.8% × cpc +3.0% ≈ +11.0% (reported +11.0%)
- Search Ads: top 3 accounts = 19% of the segment move
- Cloud: volume $2.4B of $3.2B
- Cloud: top 3 accounts = 47% of the segment move

## Watch-outs
- CapEx +61.5% to $12.6B; free cash flow $34.2B (-5.3%) despite the operating move
